pages.en:
Referred to Commandant, S.V.C. for information.
（批：C. I. D. O. REG No. 233 Date 8/4/16）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
C.S.P.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
April 6th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang has received a report from Sungkiang saying that the rebels are very active there and that a rising may be expected at any moment. This is also reported in rebel circles.
It is reported that rebels are arranging with their agents in Kiangwan to blow up some bridges on the S.N.R. between Shanghai and Woosung as soon as an attack is made on the Arsenal.
It is reported that on 5th instant General Yang received a telegram from Chiangchun Lung of Canton saying that the latter had received a telegram advising him to declare independence which purported to have been sent by Wu Ting Fang and Tong Shao Yi. The communication requested General Yang to make enquiries as to whether these gentleman had sent the telegram or not. The enquiries showed that they had not done so.
The Shanghai rebels have been told to hold themselves in readiness as the leaders think they will soon be in a position to attack the Arsenal.
An alleged rebel named Tsang Zaung Hoo was arrested at the S.N.R.Station at 11 p.m. 5th instant when he was about to board a train for Nanking. On being searched a certificate of appointment signed by Huang Hsin was found in his possession.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

转交上海义勇队指挥官知悉。
（批注：刑事调查处 登记号 233 日期 1916年4月8日）
（印章：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）
C.S.P.
上海工部局。
1916年4月6日

先生：
据报，杨将军收到来自松江的报告，称叛军在当地活动频繁，随时可能发动起义。叛军圈子内也有此类传闻。
据报，叛军正与其在江湾的代理人策划，一旦对兵工厂发起攻击，便立即炸毁上海与吴淞之间沪宁铁路线上的几座桥梁。
据报，本月5日，杨将军收到广州蒋尊簋（Chiangchun Lung，音译）发来的电报，称后者收到一封 purportedly 由伍廷芳和唐绍仪发出的电报，劝其宣布独立。该函件请杨将军查询这两位人士是否确实发出了该电报。经查证，他们并未发出此电报。
上海的叛军已被告知做好准备，因为首领们认为他们很快就能具备攻击兵工厂的条件。
一名涉嫌为叛军的男子曾庄虎（Tsang Zaung Hoo，音译）于本月5日晚11点在沪宁铁路车站准备登上前往南京的列车时被捕。经搜查，发现其身上持有一份由黄兴签署的委任状。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处总监
